children: On August 31, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it failed to meet the stockholders' equity requirement of $2.5 million under Listing Rule 5550(b)(1), reporting $633,000 as of June 30, 2026. Trading continues on the Nasdaq Capital Market, and the company has until October 15, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, with a possible extension of up to 180 days if accepted.
